objective: A run with no accessibility step reports the metric as unmeasured, never as zero
preconditions: a gate rule on accessibility, and a run that checks nothing
input: A run of a test with no checkAccessibility step, against a project with an accessibility gate rule
expected: The rule is reported as not measured and sent for review — a rule that passed because nothing looked reads as a guarantee that the page is accessible
detail: rule measured=false passed=false; outcome review; "The number of critical or serious accessibility violations was not measured for this run, so this rule could not be eval"
